_meta.label_verdict: CONTESTED BUT UNOWNED. 'AI chief of staff' is used by 10+ products globally (mostly seed-stage US/Gulf startups, one enterprise vendor - WorkBoard - with a GA 'Chief of Staff' agent since May 2025), and since Oct 21 2026 press coverage describes Anthropic's Claude Duet as a 'chief of staff' agent. The label is also being stretched to procurement (Aron) and families (Fambot). No India-based product using the label was found. No player owns it; it is becoming a generic descriptor and offers no defensible differentiation on its own.
